_generator.name: cloudguardiq
_generator.comment: Grants CloudGuardIQ read access (Reader role) at subscription scope and, optionally, assigns one or more built-in regulatory compliance initiatives (audit-only) so CloudGuardIQ can ingest Microsoft's per-control compliance evaluation. Initiative assignment is opt-in: leave policySetDefinitionIds empty to deploy Reader only. Initiative assignments are created with a system-assigned managed identity and a location because built-in regulatory initiatives contain Modify/DeployIfNotExists policies, which Azure requires an identity for (error ResourceIdentityRequired) even in audit-only enforcement.

metadata.description: Object id of the CloudGuardIQ service principal in the customer tenant. CloudGuardIQ surfaces this in the Settings UI after admin consent completes.
Built-in Reader role id. Override only if you want a more permissive role.

OPT-IN. Full resource ids of built-in regulatory compliance initiatives (policy set definitions) to assign at this subscription, e.g. '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policySetDefinitions/<guid>'. Each becomes an audit-only policy assignment so CloudGuardIQ can read Microsoft's compliance evaluation. Leave empty to deploy the Reader role only. Assigning policy requires the deploying user to hold Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments/write (Resource Policy Contributor or Owner).

properties.description: Assigned by CloudGuardIQ one-click onboarding to enable Azure Policy regulatory compliance evaluation (audit-only).
